verdict.rationale: Fivetran exposes a REST API to programmatically set up and manage pipelines/connections and a Connector SDK for building/deploying custom connectors, both of which could be scripted in CI, and hybrid deployment agents run as background processes without a UI. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, GitHub Actions integration, or documented headless CLI workflow tailored to automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration examples, a documented CLI for headless operation, and evidence of automated pipeline-as-code workflows.
